Hi Alicia — great to hear the demo resonated. I put together a short MAP and a recommended sequencing below; attaching MAP_v2.xlsx for a per-day owner chart. High-level plan:

1) Evidence & security first (parallel) — we can share a SOC2 summary and pen-test high-level within 48 hours of written NDA/POC request. Redwood maintains a SOC2 summary and a redacted pen-test report (we do not share raw logs without an LOE).

2) Legal redline window — typical internal review for standard MSA+DPA is 2-3 business weeks; if HelixCare provides a single set of consolidated redlines and limits asks to standard items (liability cap, DPA controls, audit frequency) we can often compress to 1 week.

3) Order-form & provisioning — once commercial terms (pricing and order-form) are agreed, eSignature and payment clears, pilot provisioning is typically 2 business days.

4) Escrow — Redwood does not prioritize source escrow for pilots. We can surface an escrow option for customers with enterprise contracts, but that adds procurement cycles.

Suggested actionable milestones (from MAP_v2.xlsx):
- 2025-06-09: Procurement kickoff (HelixCare)
- 2025-06-10: Redwood provides SOC2 summary + pen-test synopsis + initial MAP
- 2025-06-12: HelixCare returns consolidated redlines (if any)
- 2025-06-15 to 2025-06-19: Legal review / rapid redline cycle
- 2025-06-22: Order form signed + procurement PO issued
- 2025-06-24: Pilot provisioning complete

Ben / Monica — can you confirm the pilot provisioning SLA (2 business days) and add any onboarding steps for the customer success handoff?

Alicia — attaching MAP_v2.xlsx. I will loop Kar thik for redline guidance. If you want an accelerated cadence (single-day legal pass), we can propose a 1-week redline SLA but it requires the consolidated redline constraint.

Best,

Folks — quick legal note based on common redlines and the escrow ask:

1) MSA / DPA common items that typically extend timeline:
- Data processing scope changes (expanding categories of personal data)
- Audit right frequency and on-site requests
- Residuals / permitted use language changes
- Liability cap increases or carve-outs for security incidents

2) Escrow: adding an escrow or source-access clause materially increases procurement time (we need an escrow agreement, third-party provider, and often board/legal sign-off). For a pilot we recommend avoiding escrow; for enterprise commitments we can evaluate.

3) Suggested redline handling to hit a shortened timeline:
- Ask HelixCare to provide a single consolidated redline document (tracked or as a list) by 2025-06-12.
- Redwood legal will perform an initial pass and flag any non-starters within 3 business days. If redlines are within standard containment (liability cap at x months of fees, standard indemnity), we can do a 5-business-day turnaround.

Attachment: Redlined_MSA_comments.docx (docx) — this is a short guidance doc with the top 8 items we typically see.

If anyone wants a quick sync (30m) to review the top items, I have availability Tue 10am-12pm PT.

- Kar thik
